name: Lab Performance
query:
SELECT
 laboratory AS "Laboratory:Link/Optical Laboratory:170",
 COUNT(*) AS "Jobs:Int:80",
 ROUND(AVG(DATEDIFF(actual_return, date_sent)), 1) AS "Avg Turnaround (Days):Float:160",
 SUM(CASE WHEN actual_return IS NOT NULL AND actual_return <= expected_return THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "On Time:Int:90",
 SUM(CASE WHEN actual_return IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Still Open:Int:90",
 SUM(IFNULL(lab_cost, 0)) AS "Total Cost:Currency:110"
FROM `tabOptical Job`
WHERE laboratory IS NOT NULL AND date_sent IS NOT NULL AND status != 'Cancelled'
GROUP BY laboratory
